name: Warm up Las Condes 2026
information:
**Español** Nos complace invitarlos a esta competencia de speedcubing en el local OH Salad la cual sera un calentamiento para el campeonato sudamericano, esperamos que este sea un evento emocionante para competidores, familia y amigos. Los esperamos ansiosos!!!

**English** We are pleased to invite everyone to this speedcubing competition at the OH Salad food shop which will be a warm-up for the south american championship. We hope to make this an exciting event for competitors, family, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!
